simple.meaning: מוּת (mûwth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 839 times across Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 2:17. Its contexts include death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוּת (H4191).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מוּת (mûwth) / H4191 is traced through Genesis 2:17, Genesis 3:3, Genesis 3:4, Genesis 5:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.
